findings.title: Health Care's forward P/E sits at 85th percentile
findings.body: At 19.15, the sector's forward multiple is near its five-year high despite a 4-point one-week drop. Trailing earnings imply 86% growth, yet the 6-point gap favoring forward estimates suggests optimism is already priced in.

findings.title: Materials' trailing P/E at 93rd percentile
findings.body: With a trailing multiple of 38.93, Materials is the most expensive on reported earnings, while its forward P/E of 17.71 sits at the 44th percentile. The 49-point gap indicates the market expects a 120% earnings surge, a steep bet on future profitability.

findings.title: Energy's forward P/E jumps 20 points in a month
findings.body: Energy's forward multiple rose from cheaper levels to the 59th percentile, now at 12.60. Despite a 14-point gap favoring trailing estimates, the one-month shift suggests improving sentiment, though implied growth of 37% remains below the sector's historical peak.
